fix(pg8): parse numstat renames via -z instead of brace rewriting
Gate self-review round 3: every brace-form parse loses to some
adversarial filename (literal braces long-form, '}' inside the differing
middle). Stop parsing the rewritten form: --numstat -z emits old/new
paths as verbatim NUL records, so no filename shape can corrupt the
path. The dismissal ledger also records the stale carried README
finding as operator-dismissed (fix was already in the tip).

Co-Authored-By: Kimchi <noreply@kimchi.dev>

fix(pg8): separator-anchored brace rename parsing
Gate self-review round 2: the naive '{'-in-path detector misclassified
long-form renames with literal braces in the name
('vet/a{1}.md => b{2}.txt'). Detect the brace form only when the
separator sits inside the single brace pair; otherwise keep the
long-form split. Regression tests for both shapes plus a
brace-in-suffix brace form.

Co-Authored-By: Kimchi <noreply@kimchi.dev>

fix(pg8): apply the gate's own self-review findings
- rg_mr_consult: GH_HOST for github.* self-hosted remotes (shared
  _cli_env_extra for GHE + GL), so a GHE slug never queries public
  github.com silently
- review-gate _mr_diff_facts: parse numstat brace renames
  (docs/{old.md => new.md}) so a renamed docs file no longer
  misclassifies as code and false-blocks a docs-only MR
- README: install-git-hook.sh is the default-on installer, not an
  optional holdover
- regression tests for both defects
